subject: Request: IRP attestation + guided access to host logs for SOC 2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Diane Park <diane.park@finwave.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finwave Audit <audits@finwave.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: IRP attestation + host log access for SOC 2 / SIG review

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of Finwave's ongoing SOC 2 and SIG questionnaire reviews, our auditors have asked for two things from Redwood: (1) a signed attestation that your Incident Response Plan (IRP) in production matches the version you provided to procurement, and (2) a short session (30–45 minutes) to "navigate" a sanitized set of host/application logs so the reviewer can validate log retention/rotation and triage workflows.

Requested artifacts and constraints:
- Signed attestation (IRP v3.x or later) – PDF or DocuSign accepted.
- Log snapshot: recent host logs (1 week window), with PII redacted. We only need sample files and the mapping to retention policies.
- List of alerting runbooks tied to IRP escalation steps.

Target timeline: we hope to complete this by Nov 5 to align with our audit calendar. Can Redwood provide availability for a guided log navigation session next week and confirm whether you can produce a sanitized tarball ahead of time?

A couple of notes from the audit team: they prefer a live screen-share where Redwood walks through the logs and explains how you would triage an anomalous auth spike. If possible, include a contact who can answer infra-specific questions (hostnames, log sinks, timestamps).

Thanks — happy to jump on a call to clarify.

Best,
Diane Park
Security Operations Lead, Finwave
Diane.Park@finwave.com
Finwave Audit Team

Attachment: audit_request_checklist.pdf (stated in email, attached by Finwave)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@finwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IRP attestation + host log access for SOC 2 / SIG review

Diane —

Appreciate the clear ask. We're able to support both items but need to coordinate the sanitized log package and the navigation session. Quick plan:

1) Attestation: we'll prepare a PDF attestation (IRP v3.2) and can route it through DocuSign if you prefer signatures that way.

2) Log navigation: Marissa and Karthik will run a focused extract from our central log bucket (7-day window) and produce a sanitized tarball. We will remove fields flagged as PII and provide a manifest that maps original log types to retention policies.

3) Runbook bundle: we'll include the IR escalation matrix and a short CSV mapping alerts -> runbooks.

Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm a) whether the sample can be ready by Nov 3, and b) who can join the live navigation session (we should have someone from infra available for host-level questions)?

Diane — do you prefer DocuSign for the attestation or a signed PDF returned by email?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi all — looping in the security & compliance details.

Summary of what Redwood can deliver and the proposed schedule:

Deliverables (what we'll drop in the shared drive by Nov 3):
- redwood_irp_v3.2.pdf (attestation-ready copy)
- log-sample-hosts_20261023.tar.gz (sanitized examples, gzip) — includes syslog, app logs, and auth logs; manifests included.
- access-request-form.docx — access form auditors can sign if they need temporary console access (we do not normally permit console access to auditors).
- alert_runbook_mapping.csv — short mapping file of alert IDs to our runbooks and escalation tiers.

Sanitization and scope notes:
- PII and any customer identifiers will be redacted. We will replace hostnames with tokenized placeholders in the manifest (host-01 -> token-host-A).
- Timestamps will be preserved in ISO8601 for sequence validation.
- We will include a README describing retention policies and the log pipeline (CloudFluent -> S3 -> Glacier).

Live navigation session: proposed windows Nov 4–5, 09:00–16:00 PT. Suggested attendees: Marissa (security), Karthik (on-call infra), and an SRE from the responsible team — I can pull Tomas in if we need host-specific context.

Constraints: we can provide sanitized files for review, not full production console access. If auditors need additional context (e.g., raw hostnames or longer retention windows) we will require a signed access agreement and a temporary, audited access window.

Links:
- Drive folder (provisional): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cIRPfiles
- Proposed DocuSign flow: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/embedded?a=signature_id_12345
